Pirates: Building a Pirate Family.

Chapter 1960 Titans (Part 1)

chevron_leftPrev Nextchevron_right nights_stay

Suddenly, as if sensing something, she abruptly raised her lowered head and turned her gaze toward the dueling arena.

Her eyes, gleaming with a scarlet light like dazzling gemstones, seemed to possess a mysterious and unpredictable power, easily penetrating layers of spatial barriers to reach the target directly.

After witnessing the scene unfolding in the dueling arena, an indescribable expression appeared on Im's face.

"More trouble than they're worth!"

Im growled furiously, then turned his attention away from the five useless men.

At the same time, the four people watching the battle simultaneously felt a chill run down their spines and couldn't help but shiver.

They glanced at the direction of the flower almost simultaneously, but quickly looked away and exchanged a knowing look.

Then, the four nodded in unison, indicating that they would not mention the matter again and would pretend that nothing had happened.

At this moment, the atmosphere in the dueling arena was extremely tense.

After letting out a deafening roar, the Titan pounced straight at Satan like a maddened beast.

These two enormous creatures are incredibly large and breathtaking.

In the blink of an eye, Titan had already rushed to Satan Saint's side. Without saying a word, he swung his huge fist and smashed it down on Satan Saint with the force of a thunderbolt.

Faced with such a fierce attack, Satan Saint dared not be negligent in the slightest. He hurriedly raised his two thick forelimbs and held them across his chest, trying to block this fatal blow.

A loud clang, like the sound of metal clashing, echoed throughout the entire venue.

Satan, who had previously appeared calm and composed, suddenly became serious after suffering this unexpected heavy blow.

His six spider legs, firmly embedded in the ground, were actually dragged backward, creating six deep furrows, as if they were about to tear the earth apart.

Satan Saint's body seemed to be pushed backward by an invisible force, involuntarily.

His face was filled with disbelief, and he muttered to himself, "How is this possible..."

Before he could finish speaking, he was sent flying backward like a kite with a broken string.

With a deafening roar, Satan Saint's massive body, as large as a small mountain, crashed heavily into the open-air stands not far away.

In an instant, smoke and dust filled the air, and rubble flew everywhere, turning the once intact stands into a chaotic mess of ruins.

Satan was buried beneath these ruins, his fate unknown.

The scene before their eyes was so shocking that the other four elders present were all dumbfounded.

They stared wide-eyed at the Titan in the arena, as if they had witnessed something unbelievable.

After a long while, Maz Saint finally came to his senses. He murmured in astonishment, "Such powerful strength! No wonder that the Devil Fruit that an ordinary human ate could grant such terrifying strength, enough to easily destroy an entire country! Even Caesar of the Rockefeller family would probably be ashamed of such power."

At the same time, Nassoulang Sheng also stared intently at Rob Lucci in the arena, nodding thoughtfully.

Suddenly, Saint Vochuli burst out laughing, his laughter tinged with malice and smugness: "Hehe, this is going to be good! Saint Satan is in for a rough time!"

\"asshole!\"

With a roar, Satan Saint burst out from the wrecked ruins, his face contorted with rage.

His eight thick, powerful, spider-like legs moved rapidly, as if ready to launch a fatal attack at any moment.

At the same time, a jet-black cloud of flames suddenly appeared on its body and began to continuously release streams of dazzling purple viscous liquid.

These purple slimes streaked across the sky like shooting stars, hurtling straight toward the Titan at an astonishing speed.

Faced with such terrifying power that could easily destroy an entire skyscraper, the enormous Titan showed no fear and didn't even bother to dodge.

The purple slime slammed into its hard, thick body, instantly triggering a series of earth-shattering explosions, but it failed to cause any real damage to the Titan.

At that moment, a crimson light flashed in Satan's eyes.

The Titan, who was about to take action, suddenly stopped, as if restrained by some mysterious force.

In that extremely brief instant, Satan Saint unhesitatingly extended his eight strange spider legs and rushed towards the Titan giant with lightning speed.

Immediately afterwards, he swung his two sharp and terrifying forelimbs, and with unparalleled ferocity, he thrust them fiercely towards the Titan's head and heart.

This breathtaking strike was delivered with all its might and without mercy, completely disregarding whether the person standing in front of it was actually Rob Lucci.

At this moment, Saint Satan was blinded by rage and only wanted to teach his opponent a lesson that would never be forgotten. As for the possible consequences and related plans, he put them all out of his mind and stopped considering them.

\"die!\"

Satan Saint's eyes suddenly burst forth with a scarlet light, as if burning with raging flames. The killing intent in his eyes was so intense that it was released without reservation.

"Oh no! What exactly is Saint Satan trying to do?"

Upon seeing this, Nasshoulang Sheng's expression changed drastically, and he secretly thought that something was wrong.

He knew that this operation was of great importance, and that he was one of the participants.

If Rob Lucci were to die, not only would an extremely rare Devil Fruit be wasted, but their carefully planned scheme to infiltrate an admiral into the Navy would also be completely thwarted.

Seeing that Satan Saint was about to unleash a fatal blow, Nasshoulang Saint could no longer suppress his anxiety and worry. He suddenly stood up, ready to shout to stop him and step forward to block him.

Just as he made his move—

In an instant, the Titan, which had been standing quietly to the side, suddenly trembled, and its enormous eyes suddenly shot out a dazzling red light, like two blood-red suns hanging in the sky.

At the same time, the Titan's arms, as thick as mountains, also swung rapidly, creating an extremely sharp gust of wind.

In the blink of an eye, the Titan swiftly and decisively seized the two incredibly sharp forelimbs of the Satanic Thorn that were descending, and held on tightly.
